repo_notes.author: Ralphdex maintainers
repo_notes.content: Ralphdex is a VS Code extension and file-backed orchestration harness for reviewable agentic coding loops. It is not a general agent platform or autonomous kernel. The canonical behavioral sources are package.json, shipped code under src/, and focused repository documents under docs/; the public website is an authored product introduction.

repo_notes.author: Ralphdex maintainers
repo_notes.content: Prioritize documentation of durable .ralph/ workspace state, prompt preparation and provider execution paths, deterministic verification and provenance artifacts, stop/remediation behavior, and the command-driven operator workflows described in docs/workflows.md, docs/verifier.md, docs/provenance.md, and docs/security.md.

repo_notes.author: Ralphdex maintainers
repo_notes.content: The shipped VS Code UI is owned by src/webview/ and src/webview-ui/. The website/ React application is a separate public landing page deployed as static content in a local Docker container behind Cloudflare Tunnel. Explain this boundary explicitly and do not treat marketing illustrations as live extension functionality.
